_doc: SPEC.md §7F.1 (change add-reactive-compaction, issue #194). `detection`: isContextOverflow(status, body) must equal `overflow`. `loops`: a scripted sequence of LLM responses, one per HTTP call, in order: `text` = final answer, `tool` = one tool call (the test's tool answers 'ok'), `overflow` = the given status/body. Each loop run starts from a `history` of 8 alternating user/assistant text messages ('h0'..'h7', user first), no system prompt, prompt 'go'. The compaction hook returns the working transcript minus its FIRST message (always strictly shorter) unless `hookNoop` is true (returns nothing). Run every loop case through run AND stream, in both styles. Expect either `text` (and `compactions` = hook calls) or an error: `LlmHttpError` with `status`, or `ContextOverflowError` with `compactions` and the pinned `message`. `calls` = total HTTP calls made.
